config.label: Entra (Azure AD) app (client) id
config.description: Entra (Azure AD) app (client) id. For browser sign-in, register a public client with redirect URI http://localhost.

config.label: Directory tenant: a tenant id, or common | organizations | consumers (default common)
config.description: Directory tenant: a tenant id, or common | organizations | consumers (default common).

config.label: App secret for app-only (client-credentials) auth
config.description: App secret for app-only (client-credentials) auth. Omit to use interactive browser sign-in.

config.label: A pre-obtained Microsoft Graph bearer token (alternative to browser or app-only auth)
config.description: A pre-obtained Microsoft Graph bearer token (alternative to browser or app-only auth).

config.label: Target mailbox (user id or UPN) for app-only auth
config.description: Target mailbox (user id or UPN) for app-only auth. Omit to use the signed-in user's mailbox (/me).

config.label: Access mode: read-only | read-write | admin
config.description: Access mode: read-only | read-write | admin. Starts read-only; writes need read-write.

config.label: Set true to permit sending mail (send/reply/forward)
config.description: Set true to permit sending mail (send/reply/forward). Off by default.
